newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $103.50/dressed-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $103.50/dressed-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis were near steady, USDA said. Demand and seller interest was uneven, but fair on average.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - live basis 63.50; dressed basis 103.00-103.50, ( weighted average 103.33 ).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - live basis 63.00-63.50; dressed basis 103.00-103.50, ( weighted average 103.29 ).
For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis weak. Weekly total includes 10,600 formulated and previously contracted cattle.
For week - 63,200 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 74,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 86,000
